findings.title: New rejected-owner guard rejects genuine same-path UNMAPPED-to-REJECTED retirements
findings.actual: The guard activates when either old or new mapping_status is REJECTED, then demands old==new==REJECTED. A genuine existing UNMAPPED owner being rejected cannot satisfy this conjunction despite unchanged identity/name/path and valid appended history. Both exact committed W03 originals pass parent record validation but fail frozen d691; an independently authenticated synthetic plan passes _load then fails current prepare at this guard.
findings.impact: Regression blocks the two existing-owner retirement operations and therefore prevents the supplied933-operation cohort from completing even record validation. No overall prepare PASS exists.

findings.proposed_bounded_fix: Preserve the native route for a genuine same-path existing UNMAPPED owner becoming REJECTED with identical identifier/preferred term and required material/history provenance. Keep same-status REJECTED maintenance and forbid revival, replacement, relocation, new rejected creates or invalid promotion. Do not add a blanket status bypass or weaken complete-catalog collisions and published-origin/preimage/schema/history/inventory/publication guards. No fix is implemented by this reviewer.
required_acceptance: Add an authenticated UNMAPPED-to-REJECTED same-path retirement through native prepare, apply and completed replay.
Retain negative controls for rejected-owner revival, new rejected creation, wrong operation/path/preimage/history and changed identity/name.
Re-run the same full933-operation diagnostic without dropping either retirement; distinguish record-stage success from complete accepted prepare and actual application.
Obtain separately dispatched exact successor code review; no later commit inherits this d691 assessment.
findings.test_gap: All seven appended test functions and the first independent matrices omitted a positive incoming UNMAPPED-to-REJECTED retirement. Existing passing outcomes remain true within scope but do not establish compatibility of this missing route.
